name: Advanced Technology & Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Advanced Technology & Materials Co., Ltd. engages in providing metal materials, products, and solutions in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It offers rare earth permanent magnets; special alloys; amorphous and nano-crystalline materials; refractory materials; diamond tools, superhard materials; atomized alloy powders; metal injection molded products; hot isostatic pressed products; tool and die steels; welding materials; and environmental protection engineering. The company serves automobiles, electronics, automation and drives, energy, environmental protection, medical technology, aerospace and ship, railway, other applications.
